title: CI, Swift and skill scripts: tests.yml never runs the built intent, a stdout-before-stderr deadlock, a false LEAKED, WP directories the store never registers
body:
From dc's lane:

- `tests.yml` puts `bin/` on PATH, never the built `intent`, and its shellcheck selector `find bin -name "intent*"` matches nothing. `pr-checks.yml` watches `bin/` for source changes. CI did not run for 3.0.1 and the cut waived it.
- `IntentCLI.swift:192-194` reads stdout to EOF before stderr, so it can deadlock. `DaemonService.swift:69` sequences a restart that `daemon restart` ships.
- `tail-orphan-probe.sh:135,182` reports a false LEAKED in its guarded arm.
- `in-tca-init/scripts/tca-init.sh` makes WP directories the store never registers, and `tca-report.sh:128-144`'s guard can never fire.

Line numbers as at the audit.

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.


CLOSED 2026-09-14 (dc), all four:
- CI: `tests.yml` puts `native/rust/target/release` on PATH in both jobs, and its shellcheck selector names real files (`bin/devbin`, `bin/int`, and every file under `bin/.devbin/cmd` and `lib/templates/hooks`). `pr-checks.yml` counts `native/` changes as source. Not drivable here: the workflows run on GitHub.
- Swift: `IntentCLI.swift` reads stderr concurrently with stdout (a lock-guarded buffer and a dispatch group), so a full stderr pipe can no longer block the stdout read. `DaemonService.swift` calls the shipped `daemon restart`. Compiled with `bin/devbin macos app-build`: Debug, 3.0.3 build 7091 (scratchpad batch/judge-0335-swift.txt, 16:14:59Z).
- `tail-orphan-probe.sh` reads the original parent before the signal and tests against it. The false LEAKED did not reproduce on this host: before and after, the guarded arm reads clean and the plain control leaks (batch/judge-0335-probe.txt, 16:14:48Z, /bin/bash 3.2). So the fix is by construction.
- TCA: `tca-init.sh` creates its work packages with `intent wp new`, checks each id came back, and writes the body with `intent set`. Before, 0 of 3 WPs were registered; after, 3. `tca-report.sh`'s guard 2 asks `intent ac gate`: before, it passed with AC-01.1 unsatisfied; after, it refuses (batch/judge-0335-tca.txt, 16:14:56Z).
